intro.text: The Double Eye of the Almighty, a Vorin symbol, consists of ten circles joined by lines, the circles standing for the Ten Essences.

The Double Eye of the Almighty, a Vorin symbol nearly as old as Vorinism itself, represents the Ten Essences and how Roshar's living things came to be, and is closely tied to Surgebinding and the Knights Radiant.

description.text: The Devotary of Purity counts pictures of the Double Eye as fit subjects for Shallan to draw, and the Almighty is sometimes spoken of as if He were the Double Eye.
The name comes from its layout: Pulp and Sinew sit near the middle, like two pupils in an eye made by the other Essences.
Its ten main points stand chiefly for the Ten Essences, and fuller versions add the Ten Surges as well. It also often serves as an emblem of the Knights Radiant.
Beyond the creation of Roshar's plants and animals, it stands more broadly for the Essences and Surges that make up reality, and on a small scale for the makeup of the human body.

items.text: In one of Dalinar's visions, a Knight Radiant wore Shardplate with a simple Double Eye on the breastplate.
When Dalinar announced the refounded Knights Radiant with Amaram as their leader, Amaram's cloak bore a glyph shaped like the Double Eye.
In Urithiru, one meeting room has a version laid into its floor showing both Surges and Essences.
